summary: Preinstall hook downloads Bun runtime and executes obfuscated bundled payload
details: The package declares a preinstall hook (`node setup.mjs`) that, on `npm install`, downloads a Bun runtime archive from the oven-sh/bun GitHub releases, extracts it to a temp directory, marks it executable, and invokes it to run a bundled 727KB file named `math_init.js` shipped inside the package. `math_init.js` is a `@bun @bun-cjs` compiled bundle using obfuscator.io-style transforms (large mixed-literal string/number array, array-rotator, string-decoder function) and is not human-readable. The preinstall entrypoint `setup.mjs` is itself obfuscator.io-obfuscated (`_0xNNNN` identifiers, indirect string-lookup call wrappers). The advertised purpose is an ESLint plugin, which has no functional need for an alternate JavaScript runtime nor for running an opaque bundle at install time. Executing the payload under a freshly-downloaded Bun binary bypasses Node-based tooling that would otherwise observe the code, and the contents of `math_init.js` cannot be verified from static review.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
